note: Restore the Isolation Wall retroactively. Five packages merged with implementer-written tests (AGENTS.md 'What You Must Never Do' #11). The suite is green, but green currently means self-consistent, not correct. Each item below spawns an INDEPENDENT Test-Designer that reads only the package's brief and public contract — never its tests, never its implementation — writes verification criteria from intent, then a separate runner executes them.

imagine.item: Independently verify src/claim.lisp — the grounding door. Written by the coordinator itself, so it is the worst offender: planner, implementer and test-designer were one agent.
Independently verify src/spine.lisp — envelope contract, dynamic-binding nesting, and the ring's eviction/order across the wrap
Independently verify src/escalate.lisp — especially that resume-in-place is genuinely proven and not merely asserted by a counter the same agent wrote
Independently verify src/supervisor.lisp — real child death, real restart, real orphan-freedom under failure, not just the happy path
Independently verify src/dictionary.lisp — that it reports kinds correctly and its JSON is actually parseable by a third-party parser

Close the coordination gap structurally: a worker contract where the Tower CLAIM is a verified gate, not an instruction — the orchestrator confirms the claim landed on the board before the worker is allowed to proceed
